name: swing v4 = v3 + market-regime entry rule (F1)
entry: v3 candidate (close > prior 20-day high, IBS >= 0.7, close > SMA200) AND v3 quality model (walk-forward yearly fits on DEV, keep 0.75) AND SPY 63-day return at the signal close <= 0.03
story: breakouts that happen after a weak market lead the next leg up; after a strong 3-month run of the market a new breakout is late (the model gave spy_roc63 a negative weight in every walk-forward year)
exits: unchanged v3: next-open fill, protective stop fill - 4 x ATR(signal bar), 4 x ATR chandelier trail, exit at the next open after a close below the prior 20-day low
portfolio: max 10 positions of 10% each; same-day signals in random order (20 orders averaged)
not_accepted: all 37 profit-taking variants (A), ranking/filters (B), setup filters (C), entry timing (D), model variants (E), other regime rules (F2/F3) and every component stacked on top of F1 (G): see reports/phase2.md

holdout_run.ticker_holdout: 84 holdout tickers, entries 2015-01-01 .. latest (and the 2024-10-22+ part separately)
holdout_run.rule: run once; no fitting or changes afterwards
